management_steps.details: Deficiency - Children: 12.5 mg daily for 3 weeks. Deficiency - Adults: 25 mg daily for 3 weeks. Medicine-induced neuropathy - Children < 5 years: 12.5 mg daily for 6 months. Children >= 5 years: 25 mg daily for 6 months. Adults (medicine-induced neuropathy): 200 mg daily for 3 weeks, then follow with 25 mg daily maintenance.
Indicated for deficiency and patients on TB therapy/isoniazid.
